paite: Khau dum leh khau sandup leh khau san-au kigan in Mun Siangthou a nasepna ding siampu puante abawl ua, Aaron puansilh siangthoute abawl uhi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a bawl ahi.
heading: Siampute A Ding Puan Bawlna / (Eks 28.1-14)

paite: Khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah dangka-eng in siampu puan abawl uhi.
Dangka-eng khau leh khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih a kigan in siampu puanakzem abawl uhi.
Anunglam leh malam kaihkhawmna ding, aliangzang ah kaihna abawl ua, atunglam gei tuak akhihkhawm hi.

Atung a om, asiampu puanak siamneltak a gat leng akibang mah in anasep dungzui in; dangka-eng, khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak dungzui in gat in abawl uhi.
Onik suang abawl ua, chiamtehna gelhna a gelh, dangka- eng bulhna a bulh in, Israel suante min dungzui zel in abawl uhi.
Huaite siampu puanak liangzang ah akoih ua, Israel suante a dia theihgigena suangte hi ding in: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl hi.
Khutsiamtak in awmtuam abawl a, siampu puan bawl bang in, dangka-eng, khau dum leh khau san leh khau sandup leh khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in abawl hi.
heading: Awmtuamna Bawlna / (Eks 28.15-30)

paite: Adung-avai akikim a; awmtuamna thuah nih in abawl uhi. Asau lam khap khat ahi a, availam khap khat, thuah nih ahi.
Huai ah vual li in suang asiat ua; avual khatna sardi suang, topaz suang leh karbankul suang; hiai avual khatna ahi.
Avual nihna, emerald suang, sapphir suang leh diamond ahi.
Avual thumna, liguri suang, agate suang leh amethis suang ahi.
Avual lina, beril suang, onik suang leh jasper suang ahi a; aphuhna uah dangka-eng bulhna asiatlut uhi.
Suangte Israel suante min dungzui zel leh ahihna zah uh dungzui zel in, sawm-le-nih, chiamtehna gelhnate bang in, michih amin toh nam sawm-le-nihte gelh ahi.
Amongte ah awmtuam tung ah khainiang, dangka-engtak pakkhi abawl uhi.
Huchi in dangka-eng bulhna nih abawl ua, dangka-eng sikkual nih toh, awmtuamna mong nihte ah sikkual nihte akoih uhi.
Awmtuamna mongte a sikkual nihte sung ah dangka-eng khainiang nihte pak bang a bawl in athun uhi.
Pak khainiang nihte mong nihte suangmantam bulhna nihte ah akoih ua, ama ah siampu puan liangzang thuahna ah akoih uhi.
Dangka-eng in sikkual nih abawl ua, awmtuamna mong nihte tung ah akoih ua, agei ah sunglam pang ah siampu puanak a-om hi.
Dangka-eng sikkual nih dang abawl ua, nuailam ah siampu puanak mong nihte ah akoih uhi, amalam sang ah, akikhepna zawntak ah, siampu puanak kawnggak kigatthoh tung ah akoih uhi.
Gakna khau dum in siampu puanak sikkualte in awmtuam agakden ua, siampu puanak a pan a awmtuam akiphel theihlouhna ding in; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl uhi.
Siampu puanak puanaktual gatthoh, avek a adum a bawl ahi.
heading: Siampu Kivatna Van Dangte Bawlna / (Eks 28.1-43)

paite: Puanak tual laitak ah avang a-om a, sik puanak banbei vang bang in, akeklouhna ding a, avang kimvel in kaihna khau a-om hi.
Puanak tual mongte ah khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih in theibuhfai gahte abawl uhi.
Dangka-engtak in dak abawl ua, dakte puanaktual mong a theibuhfai gahte kikal ah, theibuhfai gahte kikal zel ah akhaisuak uhi. 26 Dak leh theibuhfai akhaisuak uhi.
Dak leh theibuhfai gahte nasepna ding a puanaktual mong kimvel ah TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl uhi.
Aaron leh atapate a ding in puanmalngat puanak tung gatthoh abawl uhi.
Puanmalngat hoih in lukhu leh puanmalngat hoih in lutuam leh puanmalngat hoih koptah in puan pheituam gek abawl uhi.
Kawnggak puanmalngat hoih koptah, khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in khuithoh in abawl uhi.
Dangka-engtak in lallukhu siangthou abawl ua, atung ah laigelh, chiamtehna gelhnate bang in, SIANTHOUNA TOUPA A AHI chih agelh uhi.
Huai ah khauhual dum akhih ua, lukhu tunglam gaktou pek ding in; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in abawl uhi.
Hichibang in khawmpite' kihoupihna biakbuk nasep tengteng zoh ahita hi. TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a thupiak bang in Israel suante'n ahihta uhi.
heading: Nasep Zohna / (Eks 35.10-19)

paite: Biakbuk leh puanin van tengteng, akibatnate, asingpekte, azawlte, akhuamte leh kingakna khuakkuakte Mosi kiang ah hon tawi uhi.
Akhuhna belampa vun diahsan leh akhuhna ngalvang vun leh akhuhna puanzak;
theihpihna bawm leh azawlte leh zahngaihna tutphah;
dohkan leh atui-um belsuan tengteng leh Pathian Ompihna tanghou sawm-le-nihte;
khawnvak koihna, khawnvakte leh atui-um belsuan tengteng leh khawnvak a dia sathau;
dangka-eng maitam leh nilh theih sathau leh gimlim leh puanin kong a ding a puankhai;
dal maitam, adal hakvang, azawlte leh atui-um belsuan tengteng tuikuang leh akhe;
huangsung puankhaite, akhuamte leh akingakna khuakkuakte leh huangsung kongpi puankhai, akhaute, akilhna zumte leh biakbuk nasepna tui-um belsuan tengteng, kihoupihna biakbuk a ding:
Mun siangthou a nasepna ding nasepna puan, hoihtak a bawlte, siampu Aaron a ding puan siangthoute leh atapate puante, siampu nasepna mun a nasepna ding,
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in, huchibang in Israel suante'n nna tengteng asem uhi.
Mosi in nasep tengteng a-en a, ngai in TOUPA thupiak bangtak in asemkheta uhi. Huchi in Mosi in huaite avualzawl hi.
